country: XK (plus Presheva / Preševo in Serbia's south valley, printed in the same book)
base: the Takvim's own computed column ('T'), valid for the whole territory
unit: minutes, one delta on every column
artifact: captures/xk-takvim-2026-p6.txt (from c37-kosovo/ks_2026.pdf page 6); cross-checked against the 2024 and 2025 prints, same page
artifactVerbatim: Sharri: T +2 min.; Ferizaj: T -1 min.; Gjilani: T -1 min.; Prishtina: T -1 min.; Podujeva: T -1 min.; Vushtrria T -1 min dhe Presheva: T -2 min.
provenance: c37-kosovo/RESULTS.md recorded the register in prose ('7 place offsets (Sharri +2, Presheva -2, five at -1)') without banking it. Re-read here from the raw PDFs: 2024 p6, 2025 p6 and 2026 p6 carry the same seven places at identical values. The 2023 print does not carry the list on any page searched.

rows.note: the Sharr mountains, the one positive rung

notes: Prishtina carries -1 against the base, so the printed column is NOT computed at Pristina. The record's XK-BIK object anchors the point at Pristina and calls it nominal; that anchor is 1 minute late for Pristina itself.
The print attributes the deltas to latitude AND elevation ('gjerësisë gjeografike ose lartësisë mbidetare'), so the register is a fused geographic+elevation ladder, not a longitude ladder.
